defs.meaning: （表示不认同）所谓的；叫做……的，号称……的

examples.en: The so-called bargain was just a big con!
examples.zh: 这种所谓的减价商品只不过是个大骗局！

examples.en: How have these so-called improvements helped the local community?
examples.zh: 这些所谓的进步对当地社会有什么帮助呢？

examples.en: It seems that the so-called new theory is likely to sink into oblivion.
examples.zh: 那所谓的新理论似乎可能被淡忘。
